name: The Ritz-Carlton, Herzliya
positioning: Marina-side hotel on the Mediterranean in Herzliya, with sea-view balconies, a rooftop pool and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a sea-view rooftop pool and spa on Herzliya Marina
Guests who like suites with large living spaces and marble bathrooms

facts.text: The hotel is set on Herzliya Marina, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, just moments from the beach.
Rooms and suites have private balconies with views of the Mediterranean Sea or Herzliya Marina.
Suites have large living spaces and marble bathrooms with standalone tubs and direct water views.
The Penthouse Suites are on the 12th floor, with convenient access to the pool.
Blends Lounge serves Afternoon Tea with a local twist.
Spa body treatments and massages feature Dead Sea minerals and indigenous herbs.
The spa has a traditional hammam.
The fitness center faces the sea and is open 24 hours a day.
Apolonia National Park is a 10 minute drive from the hotel.
The hotel holds the Forbes Travel Guide Recommended Rating for 2026.

highlights.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite was named Israel's Leading Hotel Suite 2026 by the World Travel Awards.
The hotel has a 12th-floor outdoor rooftop pool and bar with Mediterranean views.
Spa facials are performed with products from Israel's Christina skincare line.
The Rooftop Bar's signature cocktail is the Jasmine Rapture, made with gin, jasmine tea, cranberry, passion fruit and fresh lemon juice.

considerations.text: On Saturdays in honor of the Sabbath, no cooked dishes such as omelets, and no lattes or cappuccinos, are served.
Guests must be 18 or older to use the spa and fitness center.
Rooftop pool hours may differ in winter.
